name: claude-code
description: Claude Code: CLAUDE.md that imports the entry file, hooks in .claude/settings.json, Read deny rules, skills in .claude/skills.

entry-file.fills: CLAUDE.md with `@AGENTS.md`: the import works in every session

on-demand-rules.fills: the reading map of the entry file

hook-configuration.fills: .claude/settings.json: SessionStart, PreToolUse on Bash and on Edit|Write|NotebookEdit, PostToolUse on Edit|Write; the invariants are checked by `harness check scaffold`

hook-io.fills: tools/runtime-hooks/io.mjs: stdin JSON with tool_name and tool_input; a block is exit code 2 with the reason on stderr; session context is written to stdout

read-exclusions.fills: `Read(...)` rules in permissions.deny, from access.denyRead, with a rule of its own for a carve-out. They cover the file tools, @ mentions and the shell commands Claude Code recognises, not a command that reads files without naming them

procedure-packaging.fills: .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md with name and description; disable-model-invocation for explicit procedures; generated by `harness sync`

pull-request-tools.fills: the pull-request tools of the Claude desktop app: bind the pull request, and monitor its CI with automatic fixes

model-map.fills: C1 Sonnet 5.5 at medium effort, C2 Sonnet 5.5 at high, C3 Opus 5.5 at high

enforces.by: `guard-shell` refuses a commit on a protected branch
`guard-shell` refuses a commit or a push on a protected branch
`guard-shell` refuses a push to a protected branch
`guard-shell` refuses `push --delete`, `push :branch` and the API call that deletes a ref
`guard-edit` refuses the edit of an environment file; the `Read(...)` deny rules of `access.denyRead` keep secrets out of reads (best effort); nothing scans the committed content for a secret
